slides.text:
Your last episode has
hundreds of filler words in it

um, uh, like, you know

You stopped hearing them.
Your listeners didn’t

Cutting them by hand is
an afternoon per episode
Or one pass, and they’re gone

slides.heading: The pauses too
slides.body: Filler-word and silence removal run over the transcript in one pass — you keep the takes, not the dead air
